title: Your guide asks three questions at a jaunt's end
items: Check your understanding now asks three questions with real answers: where on the walk you heard something, who told you, and how sure we can be of it.
Every choice is a real stop, person or grade from that jaunt. Try again as often as you like, or ask to be shown the answer after two tries.
After you answer, "Where does this come from?" names the record behind the line in plain words. Nothing is scored or saved.
